summary: Builds a 4x4 matrix at output a1 from four packed input dwords (v6..v9) fed through EmptyStub_8bd0. Row 0 is the masked/shuffled result of AND with xmmword_8D6210 XOR xmmword_8D6200; row 1 is the xmmword_8D61F0 constant; row 2 is a re-shuffle of the masked vector; row 3 is the xmmword_8D61E0 constant. SSE math-library helper.

local_names.a2: input data source consumed by EmptyStub_8bd0
local_names.v3: first-component broadcast of the packed vector masked by xmmword_8D6210
local_names.v6..v9: four input dwords forwarded to EmptyStub_8bd0

operations.description: Invoke EmptyStub_8bd0 with the four input dwords to obtain a packed vector
Broadcast the first component of the packed vector and AND it against the xmmword_8D6210 mask
Store row 0 at offset 0: XOR the xmmword_8D6200 constant with the masked vector
Store row 1 at offset 16 from the xmmword_8D61F0 constant
Re-shuffle the masked vector into the row-2 component order
Store row 2 at offset 32 from the shuffled masked vector
Store row 3 at offset 48 from the xmmword_8D61E0 constant
Return the output matrix base a1
